Game Overview

At its heart, Hero Runner 2D Endless Run is a runner game about dash through ever-changing landscapes, avoiding trains and collecting coins to unlock new heroes in this thrilling endless runner. Hone your reflexes and master the art of timing in a race against the clock that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Can you keep up the pace?
